title: Orbital Arrow Cannon
description: This datapack adds a fishing rod which is used to summon a deadly orbital of flaming arrows which can oneshot players
body:
# Orbital Arrow Cannon using fishing rod
You must have seen the Orbital Strike Cannon and the Orbital wolf cannon being activated by fishing rods but never orbital arrow railguns. This datapack solves that problem, now you can summon a deathly railgun of arrows just using a fishing rod.

command to get the fishing rod:
```
/function orbital:rod
```
